import pytest
from subject import DefaultEnvelopeChunker, _sha256_hex

# Test envelope implementation
class TestEnvelope:
    def __init__(self, data: bytes):
        self.data = data

    def to_bytes(self) -> bytes:
        return self.data

    @classmethod
    def from_bytes(cls, data: bytes) -> "TestEnvelope":
        return cls(data)

# Helper classes for creating fake chunks with modified metadata
class FakeMetadata:
    def __init__(self, chunk_series_id, chunk_index, chunk_count, chunk_size, total_size, payload_checksum, chunk_checksum, reassembly_strategy):
        self.chunk_series_id = chunk_series_id
        self.chunk_index = chunk_index
        self.chunk_count = chunk_count
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.total_size = total_size
        self.payload_checksum = payload_checksum
        self.chunk_checksum = chunk_checksum
        self.reassembly_strategy = reassembly_strategy

class FakeChunk:
    def __init__(self, payload, metadata):
        self.chunk_payload = payload
        self.chunk_metadata = metadata
        self.envelope_headers = {}

def copy_metadata(metadata, **overrides):
    return FakeMetadata(
        chunk_series_id=overrides.get('chunk_series_id', metadata.chunk_series_id),
        chunk_index=overrides.get('chunk_index', metadata.chunk_index),
        chunk_count=overrides.get('chunk_count', metadata.chunk_count),
        chunk_size=overrides.get('chunk_size', metadata.chunk_size),
        total_size=overrides.get('total_size', metadata.total_size),
        payload_checksum=overrides.get('payload_checksum', metadata.payload_checksum),
        chunk_checksum=overrides.get('chunk_checksum', metadata.chunk_checksum),
        reassembly_strategy=overrides.get('reassembly_strategy', metadata.reassembly_strategy),
    )

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_sha256_hex():
    data = b"hello"
    expected = "sha256:" + "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824"
    assert _sha256_hex(data) == expected

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_single_chunk():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"small payload")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=100)
    assert len(chunks) == 1
    chunk = chunks[0]
    assert chunk.chunk_payload == b"small payload"
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_index == 0
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_count == 1
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_size == len(b"small payload")
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.total_size == len(b"small payload")
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.payload_checksum == _sha256_hex(b"small payload")
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_checksum == _sha256_hex(b"small payload")
    assert chunk.chunk_metadata.reassembly_strategy == "any_order"

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_multiple_chunks():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    payload = b"x" * 250
    envelope = TestEnvelope(payload)
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=100)
    assert len(chunks) == 3
    for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_index == i
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_count == 3
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.total_size == 250
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.payload_checksum == _sha256_hex(payload)
        expected_chunk_payload = payload[i*100 : min((i+1)*100, 250)]
        assert chunk.chunk_payload == expected_chunk_payload
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_size == len(expected_chunk_payload)
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_checksum == _sha256_hex(expected_chunk_payload)
    series_id = chunks[0].chunk_metadata.chunk_series_id
    for chunk in chunks:
        assert chunk.chunk_metadata.chunk_series_id == series_id

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_max_chunk_size_zero_raises():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"data")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="max_chunk_size must be positive"):
        chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="max_chunk_size must be positive"):
        chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=-1)

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_reassemble_chunk_checksum_mismatch():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"payload")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=100)
    original_chunk = chunks[0]
    fake_metadata = copy_metadata(original_chunk.chunk_metadata, chunk_checksum="sha256:wrong")
    fake_chunk = FakeChunk(original_chunk.chunk_payload, fake_metadata)
    bad_chunks = [fake_chunk] + chunks[1:]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="checksum mismatch on chunk 0"):
        chunker.reassemble(bad_chunks, TestEnvelope)

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_reassemble_full_payload_checksum_mismatch():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"payload")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=100)
    original_chunk = chunks[0]
    modified_payload = b"modified"
    fake_metadata = copy_metadata(
        original_chunk.chunk_metadata,
        chunk_size=len(modified_payload),
        chunk_checksum=_sha256_hex(modified_payload),
    )
    fake_chunk = FakeChunk(modified_payload, fake_metadata)
    bad_chunks = [fake_chunk] + chunks[1:]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Full payload checksum mismatch after reassembly"):
        chunker.reassemble(bad_chunks, TestEnvelope)

    original_chunk = chunks[0]
    fake_metadata = copy_metadata(original_chunk.chunk_metadata, chunk_series_id="different")
    fake_chunk = FakeChunk(original_chunk.chunk_payload, fake_metadata)
    mixed_chunks = [fake_chunk] + chunks[1:]
    reassembled = chunker.reassemble(mixed_chunks, TestEnvelope)
    assert reassembled.to_bytes() == b"payload"
